book.name: 1 Tɛsalonika
book.title: Ŋwa wù fwe wu Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Tɛsalonika le

content: Kinche kì Nyo koŋe

Ki mɛɛse, booŋ ba bwee wese, bee lɛge bɛŋ, bee kude lo chiaaŋ njɛ bamii ba le bo taashɛ yi Tada Jiso le, no bɛŋ gɛ̀ yɛyɛ a bee le, no bɛŋ kɛme ki bɛŋ chêe no Nyo koŋe, nyume gɛh noo, no bɛŋ chee mɛɛse, bɛŋ gêe gɛh noo bɛŋ gɛɛne lo fwe fwe.
Bɛŋ kee wa nteefɛ yi bee gɛ̀ nya bɛŋ le a bvuŋga bvu Tada Jiso le.
Fiɛɛ fì Nyo koŋe le lɛ bɛŋ yûude. Keefɛ bɛŋ jâŋe kinjaŋ gɛ.
Muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bɛŋ le kɛme ki wu kêe ki wu jîji ye ye le a je yì yuude le, yi kɛme ŋgvunɛ.
Keefɛ ye yi muh yûfe gɛh lo gɛ, yi fuu njɛ yi muh wu kituŋ ki kee gɛ Nyo gɛ.
Keefɛ muh gê kimbefɛ kɛnɛ wu gê jialɛ muh bɛ mwa bwee yi saaka wuyu wunɛ le gɛ. Bee gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa bee chiisɛ lo bɛŋ le baaŋ lo lɛ Tada lé wu gê wu nôŋ ŋgɛ yi bamii ba gee mwɛɛ munɛ le munchii.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ Nyo gɛ̀ tɛŋe besabɛŋ lɛ besabɛŋ chêe nyume kinche ki nyiɛŋ lɛ gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ tɛŋe besabɛŋ lɛ bee chêe kinche kì yuude.
Fi mo fi nyume lɛ mo yɛɛŋ wù le wu faŋ ki wu yû nteefɛ chinɛ, tu gɛ wu faŋ ki wu yû nyume muh wu wuŋ le gɛ. Wu faŋ ki wu yû nyume Nyo wù nyaa Kiyo ke ki Yuude bɛŋ le.

Fi kune kiŋkoŋɛ ki bɛŋ kɛ̂mɛ fɛ booŋ ba bwee bena ba mbɛmɛ le, gɛ fiɛɛ ka baaŋ yu fì bee ka be saŋe kune fifiɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ le gɛ. Finɛ le fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ kibɛɛ le Nyo gɛ̀ yɛyɛ wa bɛŋ no taŋlo bɛŋ koŋe bikwɛɛ biɛna.
Yi nchiɛɛŋ le, bɛŋ koŋe wa booŋ ba bwee bena bachii ba a kimbe kì Masɛdonia le. Geenɛ booŋ ba bwee wese, bee ka teefe bɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ gêe gɛh noo bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛne lo fwe fwe.
Bɛŋ moŋ lɛ bɛŋ chêe kinche kì nyiɛgee, keefɛ bɛŋ lêese jwe fɛ mwɛɛ mu bamii le gɛ. Bɛŋ lɛ̂ne bɛ chiaaŋ yene no bee gɛ̀ teefɛ bɛŋ.
Noo bamii ba akfuuŋ mo bo nyaa ŋgvunɛ fɛ bɛŋ le, bɛŋ gɛ ka bɛŋ chîɛɛne muh mu yi fiɛɛ le gɛ.
Kune kife kì Tada lé wu gê wu kâasɛ wu to
Booŋ ba bwee wese, gɛ bee goone lɛ bɛŋ nyume yi kijibɛ le kune bamii ba le ba kweeyɛ wa gɛ. Bee goone lɛ bɛŋ kɛɛ, wu lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ nyûme yii yii njɛ bamii ba jiiŋe gɛ fwe yi bvujoŋɛ bvu too le gɛ.
Besabɛŋ le be bɛɛŋ lɛ Jiso gɛ̀ bee wu kwe wu kaasɛ wu bu yi kwe le, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Nyo lé wu gê wu kâasɛ wu chvûu Jiso jiŋ bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ kweeyɛ bo nyume bo taashɛ bɛ wu.

Bee jɛme finɛ bee bii gɛh nyu jɛ yi Tada le, lɛ gɛ besabɛŋ ba shɛshi ajiŋ ba lé ba gê ba nyûme yu yi kife ki Tada lé wu gê wu tôo le, gɛ besabɛŋ nyume bee sa fwe a bamii ba le bo kweeyɛ wa le gɛ.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ Tada kibɛɛ lé wu gê wu jâ fɛwe wu shîide wu tôo wu wânɛ fɛwɛɛwe bɛ jɛ yì tɛɛme, kikwɛɛ ki banchɛndaa ba Nyo jâŋe tɛ, soŋ yi Nyo jɛ̂me. Bamii ba gɛ̀ kweeyɛ wa bo nyume bo taashɛ wa bɛ ba Kletu ya bo bu fwe.
Noo Nyo mo wu chufɛ besabɛŋ ba lé ba shɛ̂ɛ ba nyûme yu mo bo taashɛ yi kimbɛ le bee gɛɛŋ be tasɛ bɛ Tada yi kibvulɛ le. Besabɛŋ bɛ Tada mo be nyume segechii.
Noo bɛŋ mo bɛŋ jîɛɛse fitele fì muh bɛ muh bɛ njɛmɛ wunɛ.

footnotes.text: Kɛnɛ lɛ, “Muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bɛŋ le kɛme ki wu kêe no wu kɛ̂me kwɛɛ a je yì yuude le, yi kɛme ŋgvunɛ.”
